unsupported: Beijer Electronics Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of a global industrial electronics group founded in Sweden in 1981.

The American operation is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, where it supports customers across the Americas with rugged human-machine interface (HMI) hardware, distributed I/O systems, and automation software.
Engineering and final assembly are coordinated through a global supply chain; specific facility size and headcount for the Salt Lake City office are not publicly disclosed.
